value.name: UChicago merit scholarships for international students

scholarship_exists.quote: Merit scholarships are partial-tuition scholarships that may be a single lump-sum award, or a renewable annual award.
scholarship_exists.notes: Section 'Merit Scholarships for International Students'; considered independently of need; competitive. Need-based aid is also available to first-year internationals who apply at admission. Partial tuition: not a full ride.
